feed.title: enterpriseai.tools weekly updates — platforms
feed.subtitle: High-impact market intelligence for enterprise AI tooling, with an expandable release log for lower-signal product changes.

entry.title: Agent Gateway governs agents on other clouds (preview)
entry.summary: Agent Gateway for cross-cloud governance is in limited preview, free during preview. It applies identity, registry and traffic policy to agents on conformant Kubernetes clusters outside Google Cloud, such as EKS, AKS and OpenShift.

source.title: Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform release notes

entry.title: OpenAI Daybreak security models arrive on Bedrock
entry.summary: OpenAI's Daybreak Blue (GPT-5.6 Sol) and Daybreak Red (GPT-5.6 Cyber) are on Bedrock's bedrock-runtime endpoint for customers enrolled in OpenAI's Daybreak program; inference data is not used for training.

source.title: Bedrock adds bedrock-runtime endpoint support for Daybreak models

entry.title: Gemini 4 Carbon GA on Agent Platform
entry.summary: Gemini 4 Carbon and Gemini 4 Carbon for cyber are generally available on Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform; the cyber variant is limited to an allowlist program.

source.title: Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform release notes

entry.title: Claude Fable 5.2 arrives on Amazon Bedrock
entry.summary: Claude Fable 5.2 is available on Amazon Bedrock and Claude Platform on AWS. Anthropic designates Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 as covered models that require data retention, though eligible customers can use Fable 5.2 with zero data retention for now.

source.title: Claude Fable 5.2 is now available on AWS

entry.title: Claude Fable 5.2 GA in Agent Platform Model Garden
entry.summary: Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2 is generally available in Model Garden on Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, and fast mode for Claude models is generally available starting with Fable 5.2.

source.title: Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform release notes

entry.title: Bedrock adds OpenAI models and cross-Region inference in GovCloud
entry.summary: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Terra and Luna are available on Bedrock in AWS GovCloud (US) via the Responses, Converse and Chat Completions APIs, with cross-Region inference across both GovCloud Regions that keeps data in the US.

source.title: Amazon Bedrock expands API support and introduces Cross-Region Inferencing for OpenAI models in AWS GovCloud (US)

entry.title: Agent Platform computer use tool is generally available
entry.summary: The Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform computer use tool is generally available with human-in-the-loop safety controls and organization-wide guardrails. Inference request metadata logging, without prompts or responses, is also GA.

source.title: Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform release notes

entry.title: xAI Grok 4.7 is generally available on Agent Platform
entry.summary: xAI Grok 4.7 moved from preview to general availability on the Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform global and US multi-region endpoints.

source.title: Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform release notes

entry.title: OpenAI GPT-6.1 Terra is generally available on Bedrock
entry.summary: OpenAI GPT-6.1 Terra is generally available through Amazon Bedrock APIs and can also be used from ChatGPT Work and Codex configured to run on Bedrock.

source.title: OpenAI GPT-6.1 Terra is now generally available on Amazon Bedrock

entry.title: OpenAI GPT-6 models enter Google Cloud Model Garden
entry.summary: GPT-6 Astra, GPT-6.1 Sol and GPT-6 Luna are rolling out in private preview to select enterprise customers in Google Cloud's Model Garden. Gemini for business and Antigravity support are listed as coming soon.

source.title: Google Cloud expands model choice and flexibility, bringing OpenAI models to customers

entry.title: Gemini 4 Argon GA on Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform
entry.summary: Gemini 4 Argon and Gemini 4 Argon Cyber Permissive are GA on the Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform with 1,048,576-token input and output limits. Cyber Permissive is limited to an allowlist program.

source.title: Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform release notes

entry.title: Amazon Bedrock — deprecation
entry.summary: AWS announced Claude Fable 5 on Amazon Bedrock, then updated the notice to say Anthropic asked AWS to revoke access to Claude Fable 5 and Claude Mythos 5 under a US export-control directive.

source.title: AWS announces Claude Fable 5, the first generally available Mythos-class model

entry.title: Microsoft Foundry — feature
entry.summary: Microsoft announced Foundry Managed Compute, adding a managed GPU platform for hosting open-source and custom models through the same Foundry endpoint, SDKs, and billing surface used for frontier-model deployments.

source.title: Announcing Foundry Managed Compute: Run open models in Microsoft Foundry

entry.title: Amazon Bedrock — model-addition
entry.summary: AWS added Anthropic Claude Opus 4.8 to Amazon Bedrock, giving Bedrock customers access to Anthropic's latest high-end model inside AWS-managed security and regional controls.

source.title: Claude Opus 4.8 is now available on AWS

entry.title: Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform — deprecation
entry.summary: Google deprecated Vertex AI Extensions and said the service will shut down after 2026-11-26, directing teams to migrate agent integrations to Agent Platform to avoid disruption.

entry.title: Google Vertex AI — model-addition
entry.summary: Google announced Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite general availability on Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, adding a lower-latency, lower-cost production model option for agent and orchestration workloads.

source.title: Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite is now generally available

entry.title: Microsoft Foundry — feature
entry.summary: Foundry Local 1.1 added live transcription, embeddings, and Responses API support, expanding Microsoft’s local/no-cloud deployment path for speech, RAG, and tool-calling workloads.

source.title: Foundry Local 1.1: Live Transcription, Embeddings, and Responses API
